expected.rationale: linked by the load/unload program itself and mapped for its whole life

mapped only for the loaded half of each seven-second cycle; each load is recorded individually with the span it covered, so a sampling collector and an event collector can be compared over the same loads rather than over sample counts

fixture_notes.unload_verification: each load records whether it read the file, and that is decided by whether the previous cycle's unload was confirmed to have removed the mapping. After a confirmed unload nothing was held over and the file is read again; without that confirmation the load may have been satisfied from what was still mapped, and it is recorded as a cached load so it stays out of the denominator of expected reads
fixture_notes.precondition: the unload has to actually happen on the machine under test. Confirm it before measuring — the fixture check requires a load log with both a read and a cached repeat — and if the mapping never disappears, this condition measures nothing and is dropped rather than reported
fixture_notes.system_call_level_truth: none; the system-call capture rate is reported as unavailable
